title: Plateletcrit adds no clear albuminuria discrimination beyond its components: a two-cycle NHANES test
abstract: Plateletcrit may represent platelet mass, but association does not establish incremental prediction. We added count times mean platelet volume to a fixed ridge-logistic model containing both components, their squares, demographics, BMI, blood pressure, HbA1c and serum creatinine. Training used 4834 NHANES2007-08 adults20+ (637 albuminuria cases); untouched source-trained confirmation used 5375 independently sampled2009-10 adults (570 cases). Source fivefold out-of-fold deltaAUC was-0.000139. Target AUC was0.747887 versus0.747929; paired95%CI for the gain was[-0.000143,0.000227]. Joint refit and survey-weighted sensitivity did not resolve an improvement. This bounded negative result concerns incremental representation in one model, not absence of platelet-kidney biology or persistent kidney disease.
